scenario.title: Fluent but clinically cold consultation
scenario.patient_background: Concerned about visible scarring before returning to work.
patient_concerns: Will the scar be very noticeable?

transcript.content: The incision has healed as expected given the surgical approach that was used.
I'm really worried the scar will be very noticeable at work.
Scarring outcomes vary considerably between individuals and are not something I can predict definitively.
I just feel quite self-conscious about it.
You'll need to return in six weeks for a further assessment of the site.

audio.note: This benchmark contains no real audio recordings for any case. Base Intelligibility and Fluency on genuine acoustic evidence only; since none exists here, mark both status="limited_evidence", level=null for every case in this package. Do not infer pronunciation or spoken fluency from transcript spelling or word choice.
